codeReview.summary: The commit only adds tests and does not implement the feature behavior itself. The new assertions also miss a key route-prefix regression in the shared booking detail model, so the feature remains under-implemented and partially under-verified.

issues.description: The shared detail component hardcodes the unauthenticated sign-in CTA to `/auth/signin?redirectedFrom=/guest/bookings/${reservationId}`. When reused on the public `/bookings/[bookingId]` route, guests are sent back to the guest-only portal path instead of the canonical public booking detail route, breaking the required shared public/guest detail model and return-intent behavior.

This feature commit contains tests only; it does not modify `/bookings`, booking-detail routing, or lifecycle UI implementation files. The expected behavior was to implement public booking home/detail UX and canonicalization, but the diff merely adds coverage around behavior that must already exist elsewhere.

The new test suite never asserts the in-surface unauthenticated CTA generated by `ReservationDetailClient`, so it misses the public-route redirectedFrom bug above. Coverage should verify the sign-in link respects the active route prefix when the shared detail model is rendered without management entitlement.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The `guest-ui-worker` skill says to write tests first (RED) before implementation, but this worker completed a feature by landing a tests-only commit with no product-code changes. The current skill wording does not make it explicit that adding coverage alone is insufficient unless the feature description explicitly says the product already satisfies the contract and the task is validation-only.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Commit `aedf616e062c7890b06a89802bc9a9efdb7d7105` adds only `tests/guest/public-booking-pages.test.tsx`, while the feature description in mission `features.json` calls for implementing `/bookings` and booking-detail behavior.

summary: Reviewed handoff `b196dee9-8565-422e-bd28-ef8d7db710a0`, transcript skeleton, and commit `aedf616e`.
